name: friends
description: A macOS menu bar app that reminds you to stay in touch with people

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check:web: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && vite build
scripts.check:scripts: bash scripts/test-pr-title-check.sh && bash scripts/test-dependabot-auto-merge.sh && bash scripts/test-repo-settings.sh
scripts.check: npm run check:scripts && npm run check:web && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:ios: cargo clippy -p friends -p tauri-plugin-web-auth --target aarch64-apple-ios-sim -- -D warnings
